translations.web: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
translations.bsb: “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.”
translations.kjv: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
translations.asv: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
